Package io.webagent4j.common

Record Class RetryPolicy

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.webagent4j.common.RetryPolicy
Record Components:
maxAttempts - total number of attempts, including the initial call
delay - delay before the second attempt
backoffFactor - multiplier applied to each subsequent delay
maximumDelay - upper bound for an individual delay
public record RetryPolicy(int maxAttempts, Duration delay, double backoffFactor, Duration maximumDelay) extends Record
Immutable retry configuration shared by operations that may fail transiently.
